_comment: Project-level Claude Code settings. Committed to the repo and shared with the team. For local-only overrides, use settings.local.json (gitignored). Refer to Claude Code documentation for the canonical schema.

permissions._comment: Tool access permissions for this project. Tighten or expand based on project sensitivity.

auto_load._comment: Files that auto-load at session start. Order matters — earlier files take precedence.

rules._comment: Rule files that load contextually based on the current task or path.
